ingredients.limitation: 산으로서 0.5% (다만, 벤조익애씨드 및 그 소듐염은 사용 후 씻어내는 제품에는 산으로서 2.5%)

ingredients.forbidden: 금지 (과산화물가가 20mmol/L을 초과하는 d-리모넨;과산화물가가 20mmol/L을 초과하는 ㎗-리모넨;과산화물가가 20mmol/L을 초과하는 ℓ-리모넨)

reviewList.additionText: I've noticed its a lot more gentle on my skin when I lather it instead of applying it directly on my face.
reviewList.badText: since my skin barrier is damaged, using it twice a day can be too stripping
reviewList.goodText: This is my first cleanser that I've been using consistently and it's been pretty good. I have sensitive skin so I was pretty afraid that this would strip my skin barrier evern further but it did none of that. I only use it at my night routine (once per day) and lather the product wet hands before applying to the face.
